data.exact_reserve_text: The loss for the year ended 31 December 2014 is GBP 16.0m. The loss is mainly due to deteriorations in Dutch Hospital business in the Medical Malpractice class, Australian Binder in the General Liability class, sports sector in the Personal Accident class and reduction in Medical Malpractice reinsurance recoverables which collectively resulted in additional losses of GBP 27.7m. The board of MMA resolved to close the 2012 year of account at a loss of GBP 6.3m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 34.0m. This was primarily driven by deteriorations in Dutch Hospital business (Medical Malpractice), Australian Binder (General Liability), and the sports sector (Personal Accident), along with a reduction in Medical Malpractice reinsurance recoverables, collectively resulting in GBP 27.7m of additional losses. Furthermore, the 2012 year of account closed at a loss of GBP 6.3m. Separately, net claims provisions for Italian Public Hospitals (2007 & prior years) saw a net release of GBP 22.4m.
